def solve():
    import sys
    n = int(sys.stdin.readline())
    s = sys.stdin.readline().strip()
    res = []
    temp = list(s)
    while temp:
        mid = (len(temp) - 1) // 2
        res.append(temp[mid])
        temp.pop(mid)
    print(''.join(res))

solve()
